subject.summary: The Arecibo Observatory radio telescope: a 305 m spherical aluminium reflector laid in a karst sinkhole, a 900-ton instrument platform hung 150 m above it on 18 cables from three reinforced-concrete towers, with its rotating bow-shaped azimuth arm and Gregorian dome. Overall dimensions come from published parameters; the truss detail, equipment, terrain and signal cone are a reconstruction made for display.

Bow-shaped 93 m azimuth arm, 22 m Gregorian dome and counterweight
